attributes.name: Vampire Squid
attributes.powers:
When you acquire an ally or defeat a monster, reveal this card to shuffle a random card from your discard pile into your deck, then recharge this card. 

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, if you are on a ship or you are attempting a check against a bane with the Aquatic trait, add 1d8 and the Poison trait to your combat checks.
